purpose: Qualitative, source-linked feature contract for one connected head; it supplies no dimensions or acceptance result.

full_bird_context.scope: Full-bird canon; maintain context without expanding July head scope

connected_features.source_anchor: deep, long hooked bill; PRD V03 requires deep convex hook, tip curvature and jaw silhouette
connected_features.relationship: Read upper bill as a deep hooked form connected to the lower jaw; keep cheek negative space readable. No authored dimensions.

connected_features.source_anchor: cheek opening; PRD V03 cheek negative space
connected_features.relationship: Treat opening and mandible as connected visible forms, not a painted marking or unsupported topology claim. Exact hidden construction remains proposal.

connected_features.source_anchor: swept crown; PRD V04 swept segmented crown
connected_features.relationship: Keep crown sweep and segmentation legible as part of the same head assembly. No count, angle, length or proportion target supplied.

connected_features.source_anchor: recessed circular optic; PRD V04 recessed housing, relative eye scale and facial severity
connected_features.relationship: Represent the optic as circular and recessed within its brow relationship; no numeric eye scale or recess depth supplied. Era power eligibility follows source evidence.

cross_feature_constraint: Judge bill/jaw, cheek opening, crown and optic/brow together as one connected head identity, then in whole-bird context. Do not optimize isolated details at the expense of the reference identity.
unsupported_or_deferred: No measurements, coordinates, scale, angles, ratios, tolerances or invented dimensions.
No inferred backside topology or unseen construction stated as source fact.
No changes to body, stance, material finish, motion, animation, rig, mechanics or engineering.
No owner likeness acceptance; source likeness remains UNMET per current goal.
Implementation requires separate explicit current scope and owned allocation; this contract itself authorizes none.
evidence_status: Reference scope and wording confirmed from goal.md and docs/murderbird-evaluation-prd.md; feature contract is a proposal bounded by those sources.
